mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO rises > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is above 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, signaling a restrictive monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS decreases > 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a month signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST rises > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% YoY and Industrial Production (INDPRO) is flat or declining, it signals supply-side constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where GDPC1 YoY < 2% and INDPRO is flat/declining.
